milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The player must navigate near the yellow terracotta structure (centered at spawn-relative [4, 2, 4]) and face it, confirming they have visually located it. max_distance=16 allows detection from reasonable range, facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is actually looking at it.

Uses count_in_box_at_most (kind='block') because mining glass without silk touch drops nothing, so inventory_has cannot be used. Instead, we verify that at least one brown_stained_glass block has been removed from the structure's bounding box. The original structure contains 28 blocks (3x3x4 solid cube = 27 + 1 cap block). Setting max_count=27 means at least 1 block must have been mined. The box generously covers the entire structure area with ±1 padding.
